def forward(self, input_tensor: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
        """
        Args:
            input_tensor: X, shape = (batch_size, num_channels, H, W)
                For 3d X, shape = (batch_size, num_channels, T, H, W)
            output tensor
        """

            self.channel(input_tensor), self.spatial(input_tensor)
